transcript: Speaker A: Most people can read in English, but when a native speaker speaks fast, they don't understand. It's not your fault - real conversations are fast and full of emotion. That's where I come in. I'm Loora, your AI English tutor. We'll practice listening and speaking together every day - just like you would with a real person. I'll help you get used to real speed, correct your pronunciation, and guide you through mistakes - gently. No stress. No pressure. Just natural English that gets better every day. And in just three weeks, you'll start understanding everything people say - and speaking with real confidence. Speaker B: You watch movies in English, you read posts in English, you understand almost everything, so why can't you speak? Here's the truth: your English is closer than you think. The words are in your head, you just need practice to get them out. I'm Loora, your AI English tutor. Talk to me everyday and I'll help you turn what you understand into what you can say. I'll fix your mistakes, help your pronunciation, and make you feel more confident every time we speak. You're not starting from zero, you're almost there. Speak with me and unlock your English.
